candidate_statement: Some maximum-product eligible state is either directly insertable or has an eligible insertable state obtained by replacing one good in a source bundle with the floater and permuting the resulting bundles.
claim_boundary: This is a finite corpus scan of a proof selector. It neither proves complete additive EFX nor searches for an additive EFX counterexample.
meaning: For every exact maximum-product eligible state, test direct insertion and, when blocked, every source-good substitution followed by every bundle permutation. Survival on this finite corpus is not a theorem.
